proposition: The poet Kātibī Turshīzī (d. 839/1436) was among his Yazd students and is said to have been converted to the Sufi path at his hand; the first four poems of Kātibī's divan eulogize his teacher, praising his learning and scrupulous application of the law as qadi.

mediation.note: 'said to have been' converted; the poems are panegyric
